container: background-color: #f5f8f5; padding: 40px 10px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
card: background-color: #ffffff; background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(107,155,122,0.08) 1px, transparent 0); background-size: 18px 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(107,155,122,0.1); border-radius: 16px; padding: 25px; margin: 0 0 40px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(74,128,88,0.08), 0 0 12px rgba(107,155,122,0.2)
p: font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.75; color: #3d4a3d; margin: 0 0 16px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; text-align: left; margin: 0 0 20px; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(74,128,88,0.25)
h2_first: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; text-align: left; margin: 0 0 20px; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(74,128,88,0.25)
h3: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #447550; text-align: left; margin: 26px 0 12px; padding-bottom: 4px; border-bottom: 2px solid #6b9b7a; display: inline-block
blockquote: background-color: #e8f0e8; border-left: 5px solid #6b9b7a; box-shadow: inset 0 0 12px rgba(107,155,122,0.1); padding: 16px 20px; margin: 0 0 16px; color: #5c6a5c; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
pre: background-color: #eef4ee; border: 1px solid rgba(107,155,122,0.2); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 18px
code: color: #3d4a3d; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.6; font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, Menlo, Monaco, monospace
inline_code: background-color: #e8f0e8; color: #447550; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; letter-spacing: 0; font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, Menlo, Monaco, monospace
th: background-color: #e8f0e8; color: #447550; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid rgba(107,155,122,0.18); padding: 9px 12px; font-size: 14px
td: border: 1px solid rgba(107,155,122,0.18); padding: 9px 12px; font-size: 14px; color: #3d4a3d
